newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analysts' comments on Heineken 96 results.
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on Heineken 96 results.

text.p: Dutch brewer Heineken NV on Friday reported 1996 net profits of 655 million guilders against 664 million in 1995. Analysts had expected Europe's largest brewer to post a net of between 630 and 660 million guilders.
The company said it expected to see profit growth in 1997, but could not yet say how much.
Below is a collection of analysts' comments on the results:
"The figures are somewhat at the upper range of expectations, the composition looks fine. As expected, acquisitions added to the increase in turnover.
"The outlook is interesting. Heineken is cautious and it looks as if it is trying to temper expectations somewhat.
"What it says about the shift towards drinking at home isn't new. We've been seeing that in England for a while and England often is ahead of the other markets.
"But they say the company will only benefit to a small extent from the dollar's appreciation in 1997 as they have hedged cash flows for some time.
"I think that will disappoint some, as they had expected Heineken to benefit much more from the dollar's rise."
